sloka: तम् आहवे दारुणम् आशु विक्रमौस्थिरौ उभौ संयति राम लक्ष्मणौ ।मुदान्वितौ चिक्षिपतुर् भयावहम्नदन्तम् उत्क्षिप्य बिलेन राक्ष्सम् ॥३-४-२९॥
transliteration: tam āhave dāruṇam āśu vikramausthirau ubhau saṁyati rāma lakṣmaṇau ।mudānvitau cikṣipatur bhayāvahamnadantam utkṣipya bilena rākṣsam ॥3-4-29॥

translations.english: The two princes, bulls among men, who were adept in archery saw that the great demon could not be killed by any other means. They reflected over the issue and undertook the task of killing him with sharp weapons and buried him in a pit.
